MSFT.name: Microsoft

GOOGL.name: Alphabet
GOOGL.notes: Q2 2026 10-Q. AVGO.notes: Q3 FY2026 10-Q (quarter ended Aug 2 2026). No lease rows on stockanalysis; total_debt is borrowings. Cash is cash & equivalents only (no marketable securities reported). Q4 FY26 report due Dec 2026.

TSLA.name: Tesla
TSLA.notes: Q3 2026 reported today after close. NI, D&A, SBC, OCF, capex, interest are company-reported TTM; revenue and op income TTM = stockanalysis Jun-2026 TTM + Q3'26 - Q3'25 (28.046 vs 28.095; 0.718 vs 1.624). SPCX.name: SpaceX
SPCX.source: Q3 2026 release (8-K Ex 99.1, Oct 20 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm ; IPO prospectus 424B4: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001181412/000162828026042639/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm ; FY2025 values: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/spcx/financials/income-statement/?p=trailing ; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/spcx/financials/cash-flow-statement/?p=trailing ; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/spcx/financials/balance-sheet/?p=quarterly
SPCX.notes: Q3 2026 reported Oct 20. TTM built as FY2025 - 9M2025 + 9M2026 (9M from Q3 release; FY2025 from stockanalysis/prospectus). revenue_growth_yoy_pct is Q3 quarter YoY (14.575 vs 5.576), NOT TTM; TTM prior-year revenue not found. Operating income uses prospectus FY2025 loss from operations (-2.589); stockanalysis shows FY2025 op income -2.064, which would give TTM -0.143, so op income is uncertain. Q3 2026 alone was profitable (op inc 2.791, NI 4.404). Net income is total (9M attributable to shareholders was -1.084 vs -0.413 total). SBC includes 1.217 acquisition-related SBC in 2026. total_debt = debt AND finance leases combined (2.698 current + 36.146 non-current). shares_diluted 12.475B is Q3 weighted-average diluted, up from 2.941B a year earlier (IPO plus share issuance/merger; Q2 2026 was ~3.9B), so period-end count may differ. Capex = purchases of PP&E (cash flow), excludes finance-lease principal.

definitions: US$ billions. Capex is purchases of property and equipment (Meta's includes finance-lease principal as it reports). Debt excludes leases except Tesla and SpaceX. Cash includes short-term investments, not long-term. Equity attributable to the parent. Alphabet and Amazon net income include large non-operating gains.
